Provide a documented handover with access, runbooks and change responsibilities.
Review capacity, service risks and support demand at agreed intervals.

pillars.title: Payments & fintech engineering
pillars.description: Connect payment devices, providers and settlement records into reliable workflows.
scope: Integrate authorised payment providers and device interfaces.
Reconcile transaction, refund, fee and settlement records.
Define failure handling and review exceptions before financial adjustments.

pillars.title: Quality assurance & testing
pillars.description: Test the behaviour, performance and integration risks that matter before release.
scope: Translate critical workflows into measurable acceptance criteria.
Exercise integration failures, recovery and representative workload conditions.
Report release risks with reproducible evidence and a correction path.

pillars.title: IoT & embedded systems
pillars.description: Connect devices and sensor information to useful operational actions.
scope: Map device identity, connectivity, telemetry and data quality.
Plan firmware updates, offline behaviour and authorised device actions.
Validate sensor readings before using them to influence operational decisions.

pillars.title: Systems integration & APIs
pillars.description: Make existing applications exchange information without losing ownership or context.
scope: Establish source-of-truth ownership and approved field mappings.
Handle retries, duplicate events, failures and reconciliation explicitly.
Document interfaces, permissions and the team responsible for each boundary.

scenarios.title: A harvest has a buyer, but the delivery window is already at risk
scenarios.problem: Harvest planning, vehicle availability and buyer acceptance windows are handled separately, leaving a usable crop waiting between stages.
scenarios.build: A harvest-to-dispatch board connecting field availability, packing capacity, bookings and agreed delivery windows.
scenarios.ai: Rules expose missed dependencies; forecasting estimates readiness ranges from historical field and packing data.
scenarios.boundary: A farm manager confirms harvest changes. Weather and weak sensor data widen the estimate rather than produce a false exact time.
scenarios.measure: Waiting time between harvest and dispatch, rejected deliveries and forecast error.
scenarios.visual: A field-to-buyer timeline with a highlighted missed handoff.

scenarios.title: One sensor sends the farm in the wrong direction
scenarios.problem: A drifting moisture sensor can look like a genuine irrigation need.
scenarios.build: Sensor-health checks alongside irrigation recommendations, maintenance records and manual observations.
scenarios.ai: Compare neighbouring readings and historical behaviour to flag questionable data. Apply deterministic operating limits.
scenarios.boundary: AI cannot override irrigation safety limits; uncertain readings trigger inspection. Agronomic decisions remain with the responsible team.
scenarios.measure: False alerts, faulty-sensor detection and unnecessary interventions.
scenarios.visual: Two paths from the same reading: inspect the sensor or review irrigation.

scenarios.title: Repeated maintenance closes tickets without removing the cause
scenarios.problem: Similar failures recur under different descriptions across sites and shifts.
scenarios.build: A maintenance-history workspace linking asset identity, work orders, replaced parts and inspection evidence.
scenarios.ai: Cluster similar reports and retrieve relevant previous fixes with source links.
scenarios.boundary: Engineers confirm the cause; suggested similarity is not a diagnosis. No autonomous changes to industrial controls.
scenarios.measure: Repeat work orders, search time and proportion of suggestions accepted after review.
scenarios.visual: A recurring fault thread crossing several closed work orders.

scenarios.title: A waste load changes hands but the evidence does not
scenarios.problem: Collection, weighbridge and treatment records disagree, making it difficult to explain where a load went.
scenarios.build: A digital handover trail with unique load IDs and reconciled source documents.
scenarios.ai: Rules compare quantities and timestamps; document extraction assists with legacy weighbridge tickets.
scenarios.boundary: Unknown destinations stay unresolved. A digital record cannot certify lawful treatment without external evidence.
scenarios.measure: Unmatched handovers, missing-document age and correction effort.
scenarios.visual: Chain-of-custody links with one incomplete handover.

scenarios.title: Engineering changes reach purchasing after parts are ordered
scenarios.problem: An approved design revision does not propagate to bills of materials, purchase orders and work instructions.
scenarios.build: A change-impact workspace linking approved revisions to affected material and production records.
scenarios.ai: Deterministic revision rules identify conflicts; document comparison summarises differences for engineers.
scenarios.boundary: AI never approves a replacement part or releases a revised instruction. Changes require the authorised reviewer.
scenarios.measure: Obsolete-version usage, review time and missed affected orders.
scenarios.visual: One drawing revision illuminating its downstream dependencies.

scenarios.title: A quality issue triggers too wide—or too narrow—a recall review
scenarios.problem: Teams cannot quickly identify which assemblies used a questionable batch.
scenarios.build: Component genealogy and containment-review tooling linking receipts, batches, assemblies and shipments.
scenarios.ai: Graph queries find known relationships; extraction helps recover missing legacy records for review.
scenarios.boundary: Quality staff decide quarantine, release or recall. Missing traceability is displayed, not filled with an invented relationship.
scenarios.measure: Trace completeness, time to identify affected stock and erroneous associations.
scenarios.visual: A selected batch spreading through a product lineage diagram.

scenarios.title: A completed job cannot be handed over because evidence is missing
scenarios.problem: Installed assets lack approved test results, warranties or as-built documents at handover.
scenarios.build: An asset-level completion dossier with required-document checklists and subcontractor follow-up.
scenarios.ai: Extract document references and flag missing or inconsistent fields; rules check the approved handover requirements.
scenarios.boundary: The responsible engineer signs off compliance and acceptance. AI cannot certify a test it has not witnessed.
scenarios.measure: Missing evidence at handover, rework requests and closeout age.
scenarios.visual: A building asset opening into its document dossier.

scenarios.title: A tenant complaint crosses teams without a clear owner
scenarios.problem: A recurring issue is split between property management, contractors and building operations.
scenarios.build: An issue timeline connecting work orders, access appointments, equipment and tenant updates.
scenarios.ai: Summarise the history and suggest related tickets; rules assign responsibility and escalation.
scenarios.boundary: Staff confirm fault attribution; the system does not rank tenants or infer sensitive personal characteristics.
scenarios.measure: Reopened complaints, unowned time and missed appointments.
scenarios.visual: A swimlane showing where responsibility stalled.

scenarios.title: Small settlement mismatches accumulate unnoticed
scenarios.problem: Provider fees, refunds and settlement timing create differences that are difficult to reconcile across payment rails.
scenarios.build: A reconciliation workbench with source records, verified fee rules and a visible exception queue.
scenarios.ai: Deterministic matching handles normal entries; AI proposes explanations for unresolved descriptions.
scenarios.boundary: A finance user approves adjustments. No model-generated journal entry posts without validation and authorisation.
scenarios.measure: Unmatched value and count, exception age, reviewer effort and incorrect proposed matches.
scenarios.visual: Transaction, settlement and ledger lanes converging at an exception.

scenarios.title: A claim is delayed by missing evidence, not a difficult decision
scenarios.problem: Customers repeatedly supply documents because requirements and case status are unclear.
scenarios.build: A claims-evidence checklist and staff review workspace connected to approved policy requirements.
scenarios.ai: Extract fields and flag missing documents. Rules manage completion and follow-up.
scenarios.boundary: No automatic denial, underwriting decision or fraud accusation. Claim decisions remain with authorised staff and existing appeal processes.
scenarios.measure: Repeat document requests, completeness at first review and false missing-document flags.
scenarios.visual: A case progressing through evidence readiness to human assessment.

scenarios.title: A referral leaves one clinic but never becomes an appointment
scenarios.problem: Referral receipt, document completeness and booking responsibility are not visible across teams.
scenarios.build: Closed-loop referral tracking with an acknowledgement, missing-information queue and scheduling status.
scenarios.ai: Extract permitted administrative fields and summarise correspondence; deterministic rules track unresolved handoffs.
scenarios.boundary: Clinical urgency and suitability remain with clinicians. No inference that an unbooked referral is medically safe to wait.
scenarios.measure: Unacknowledged referrals, administrative turnaround and extraction errors.
scenarios.visual: A referral moving between sender, receiving team and booking, with a visible return path.

scenarios.title: Medicine stock exists, but no one can verify its handling history
scenarios.problem: Temperature records, batch identifiers and supplier documents are disconnected when a product needs review.
scenarios.build: A batch evidence workspace joining inventory and available cold-chain records.
scenarios.ai: Rules identify missing intervals and threshold excursions; document extraction links candidate records.
scenarios.boundary: Pharmacists or quality personnel decide quarantine and release. AI cannot establish medicine safety or recommend substitution.
scenarios.measure: Missing-record rate, review time and false batch matches.
scenarios.visual: A batch timeline with an explicitly unknown temperature interval.

scenarios.title: Inventory is technically available but cannot be sold
scenarios.problem: Returned goods, incomplete bundles and damaged stock inflate the available-to-promise count.
scenarios.build: A stock-status workflow separating saleable, awaiting inspection, incomplete and quarantined items.
scenarios.ai: Rules calculate sellable stock; image/document assistance can prepare inspection suggestions.
scenarios.boundary: A reviewer approves condition and resale eligibility. AI does not silently mark an item safe or authentic.
scenarios.measure: Orders cancelled after purchase, inventory-status errors and inspection queue age.
scenarios.visual: One inventory total unfolding into distinct usable and blocked quantities.

scenarios.title: A promotion creates demand the replenishment process cannot meet
scenarios.problem: Marketing campaigns, lead times and store-level inventory are planned independently.
scenarios.build: A promotion-readiness workspace connecting planned campaigns, stock, supplier lead times and distribution capacity.
scenarios.ai: Forecast demand ranges and compare them with rules-based supply constraints.
scenarios.boundary: Merchandising approves orders and campaign changes. Forecasts show uncertainty; they are not purchase commitments.
scenarios.measure: Promotion stockouts, excess stock after campaigns and forecast error against a baseline.
scenarios.visual: A demand range meeting a replenishment timeline. Link marketing work to Tubblor.

scenarios.title: A container is ready, but missing paperwork keeps it in port
scenarios.problem: Documents and release milestones are checked only after avoidable delay has started.
scenarios.build: A shipment document checklist, event integrations and an assigned exception queue.
scenarios.ai: Extract dates and references; deterministic rules calculate deadlines from validated terms.
scenarios.boundary: An operator verifies matches and approves external instructions. Unknown release conditions stay visible.
scenarios.measure: Late-document incidents, exception age and charges attributable to avoidable delays.
scenarios.visual: Port-to-warehouse path interrupted by a specific missing document.

scenarios.title: A cold-chain dispute has data, but no shared timeline
scenarios.problem: Carrier scans, sensor logs and handover records use different identifiers and clocks.
scenarios.build: A time-normalised shipment evidence view with data-quality markers.
scenarios.ai: Rules align verified identifiers and time zones; AI suggests candidate document associations.
scenarios.boundary: The system flags evidence gaps, not legal liability. Operators verify associations before sharing an evidence pack.
scenarios.measure: Time to assemble the record, unresolved clock conflicts and wrong associations.
scenarios.visual: Parallel carrier and sensor timelines aligning at handovers.

scenarios.title: A room appears available while maintenance blocks its use
scenarios.problem: Booking inventory and maintenance/housekeeping status do not update each other reliably.
scenarios.build: A room-readiness board linking confirmed maintenance holds, inspections and arrival priorities.
scenarios.ai: Rules prevent conflicting availability; forecasting estimates readiness ranges from historical tasks.
scenarios.boundary: Staff release rooms after checks. AI cannot override a safety-related hold.
scenarios.measure: Arrival-time room conflicts, overdue holds and readiness estimate error.
scenarios.visual: An arrival board showing the task that blocks room release.

scenarios.title: A menu change leaves old ingredient information in circulation
scenarios.problem: Supplier substitutions and recipe updates do not propagate to menu and staff reference systems.
scenarios.build: A versioned ingredient and approval workflow connected to approved menu data.
scenarios.ai: Extract supplier changes for review; deterministic rules require authorised updates and sign-off.
scenarios.boundary: Never let a generative model decide that food is allergen-free. Qualified staff approve the authoritative ingredient record.
scenarios.measure: Unreviewed substitutions, outdated versions and time to distribute an approved correction.
scenarios.visual: One ingredient change reaching recipes, menus and staff references.

scenarios.title: A licensed asset is reused outside its allowed territory or period
scenarios.problem: Rights information lives in contracts separate from publishing workflows.
scenarios.build: An asset-rights register with territory, channel and expiry checks linked to publishing approvals.
scenarios.ai: Extract candidate clauses for legal review; approved rules flag proposed reuse conflicts.
scenarios.boundary: Legal or rights staff interpret ambiguous terms. AI cannot clear a licence.
scenarios.measure: Assets lacking rights metadata, review time and incorrect conflict flags.
scenarios.visual: A publishing route crossing a rights checkpoint.

scenarios.title: Live event changes do not reach all operational teams
scenarios.problem: A venue or programme change leaves ticketing, staff briefings and access information inconsistent.
scenarios.build: A controlled change register with affected channels and acknowledgement tracking.
scenarios.ai: Draft channel-specific notices from approved changes; rules track who must review and publish.
scenarios.boundary: A responsible person approves public announcements. Safety instructions come from authorised staff, not generated guesses.
scenarios.measure: Conflicting published information, unacknowledged changes and correction time.
scenarios.visual: A change branching to channels with explicit approval status.

scenarios.title: A timetable is valid on paper but fails in practice
scenarios.problem: Room equipment, accessibility needs and travel time are missing from timetable constraints.
scenarios.build: A constraint-based planning board joining courses, rooms, equipment and approved availability.
scenarios.ai: Optimisation compares valid schedules; explanations show which constraints cause conflicts.
scenarios.boundary: Administrators approve changes. Minimise sensitive student information and avoid automated opportunity allocation based on inferred traits.
scenarios.measure: Unresolved clashes, manual rescheduling and unmet documented requirements.
scenarios.visual: A room assignment revealing an equipment or accessibility conflict.

scenarios.title: Training completion is confused with demonstrated competence
scenarios.problem: Attendance records are treated as evidence that a learner can perform a practical task.
scenarios.build: A skills-evidence portfolio connecting practical assessments, assessor notes and required competencies.
scenarios.ai: Retrieve relevant evidence and flag missing assessment records.
scenarios.boundary: An authorised assessor decides competence. AI does not grant credentials or reject a learner.
scenarios.measure: Missing evidence at review, assessor search time and incorrect evidence associations.
scenarios.visual: A certificate requirement opening into verified evidence items.

scenarios.title: A request is sent to the wrong department repeatedly
scenarios.problem: Citizens use everyday language that does not match internal service categories.
scenarios.build: A service-intake and handoff system using approved service descriptions and routing rules.
scenarios.ai: Suggest categories, translate permitted text and summarise the request for staff.
scenarios.boundary: Ambiguous cases go to review. No automatic benefit denial or determination of eligibility from the text classifier.
scenarios.measure: Misrouting, repeat handoffs and accessibility/language performance.
scenarios.visual: A request choosing between clear service routes, with an uncertainty branch.

scenarios.title: Guidance changes, but front-line answers use an older version
scenarios.problem: Public-service staff search across circulars and instructions with conflicting effective dates.
scenarios.build: A versioned, source-linked guidance library with validity dates and ownership.
scenarios.ai: Retrieve current authorised passages and draft an answer; flag unresolved contradictions.
scenarios.boundary: No invented rule or legal determination. Conflicting guidance triggers review by its owner.
scenarios.measure: Outdated-source retrieval, unsupported statements and time to locate authoritative guidance.
scenarios.visual: Competing document versions resolving to an approved source—or no answer.

scenarios.title: Reusable knowledge accidentally carries confidential client detail
scenarios.problem: Teams want to reuse previous work without crossing client confidentiality boundaries.
scenarios.build: A permission-aware knowledge library with approved reusable material and client-specific collections.
scenarios.ai: Retrieve and summarise only authorised records, with source links and access checks.
scenarios.boundary: Enforce access outside the model, test cross-client leakage and require review before external reuse.
scenarios.measure: Retrieval relevance, unsupported answers and attempted access-boundary violations.
scenarios.visual: A knowledge request reaching permitted sources while another collection remains inaccessible.

scenarios.title: A signed contract commitment never becomes an operational task
scenarios.problem: Renewal, reporting and notice obligations are missed because they remain in documents.
scenarios.build: A reviewed obligations register linking clauses to owners, dates and evidence of completion.
scenarios.ai: Extract candidate obligations; rules schedule reminders after human validation.
scenarios.boundary: Legal or contract staff approve interpretation. AI does not issue a legal notice or amend a contract.
scenarios.measure: Unassigned obligations, missed deadlines and extraction accuracy after review.
scenarios.visual: A clause becoming a reviewed task with an owner and due date.

scenarios.title: Restricted donations are difficult to reconcile with spending
scenarios.problem: Donor restrictions and project expenses sit in separate records.
scenarios.build: A fund-allocation ledger with approved purpose rules, receipts and exception review.
scenarios.ai: Extract receipt fields and suggest categories; deterministic controls check approved allocations.
scenarios.boundary: Trustees or finance staff approve expenditure. AI cannot redirect funds or decide religious eligibility.
scenarios.measure: Unmatched spending, review backlog and incorrect category suggestions.
scenarios.visual: Donation-to-project flow with an out-of-purpose allocation stopped for review.

scenarios.title: A volunteer handover leaves a service uncovered
scenarios.problem: Availability, role requirements and completed checks are tracked separately from shift assignments.
scenarios.build: A rota and handover system showing authorised role eligibility and coverage gaps.
scenarios.ai: Constraint-based scheduling suggests coverage; summaries support handover of permitted operational details.
scenarios.boundary: Coordinators approve assignments. No facial recognition, inferred suitability score or automated safeguarding judgement.
scenarios.measure: Unfilled shifts, missing handovers and assignments needing correction.
scenarios.visual: A service roster with an uncovered role and valid alternatives.

scenarios.title: There is rack space, but not enough usable resilient capacity
scenarios.problem: A workload placement fits physical space while exceeding a power, cooling or redundancy constraint.
scenarios.build: A capacity-planning model joining racks, circuits, cooling zones and agreed resilience assumptions.
scenarios.ai: Deterministic constraint checks and scenario modelling; optional forecasting of demand ranges.
scenarios.boundary: Qualified engineers approve placement. A website animation is not a thermal, electrical or safety validation.
scenarios.measure: Planning-data completeness, conflicts detected before installation and forecast error.
scenarios.visual: A workload entering a rack while its limiting resource becomes visible.

scenarios.title: Recovery plans depend on an asset record that is no longer correct
scenarios.problem: Configuration inventories, dependencies and recovery runbooks drift apart after changes.
scenarios.build: A dependency register with change reconciliation and recovery-test evidence.
scenarios.ai: Compare available records and retrieve relevant runbook sections; rules flag unresolved discrepancies.
scenarios.boundary: Engineers validate dependencies and execute authorised tests. AI does not autonomously trigger production failover.
scenarios.measure: Stale dependencies, recovery-test exceptions and time to assemble an accurate runbook.
scenarios.visual: A failover path exposing an unverified dependency.

scenarios.title: An AI feature succeeds with users but loses money on each transaction
scenarios.problem: Model calls, retries and shared infrastructure costs are not allocated to useful completed tasks.
scenarios.build: A tenant-aware cost and outcome dashboard with budgets and request tracing.
scenarios.ai: Rules calculate actual unit cost; anomaly detection highlights unusual usage or repeated failed attempts.
scenarios.boundary: Do not expose another tenant's data. Cost controls must preserve an explicit user-facing failure or fallback path.
scenarios.measure: Cost per completed task, unsuccessful retries and attribution coverage.
scenarios.visual: One task unfolding into its model calls, retries and measurable cost.

scenarios.title: An incident is visible, but the affected customers are not
scenarios.problem: Service alarms cannot be reliably mapped to customer-facing features and dependencies.
scenarios.build: A service-impact map joining dependency records, deployments and permitted account information.
scenarios.ai: Summarise incident evidence and suggest affected components; rules manage verified status updates.
scenarios.boundary: Engineers confirm impact and approve customer communications. Unknown impact remains explicitly unknown.
scenarios.measure: Time to identify affected services, incorrect impact claims and update consistency.
scenarios.visual: A dependency failure highlighting the services that may be affected, separately from confirmed impact.
